description: Unmodified builder and template defaults: decisions that were skipped, not evidence of who or what wrote the code. Patterns informed by the public tell-catalogs of kill-ai-slop (yetone, 33 tells), SlopCop, and Slopdar. Never an authorship claim.

rules.message: The document title is a scaffold default (Vite + React, Create Next App, React App, v0 App); the naming decision was skipped.
rules.false_positive_guard: A framework's own documentation site legitimately carries its name; confirm the product context.

rules.message: A generator meta tag ships in production markup; harmless, but usually travels with other unreviewed defaults.
rules.false_positive_guard: Some CMSes require it for support tooling; treat as a pointer, not a defect.

rules.message: A builder attribution badge (built with lovable/v0/bolt/replit) remains in the shipped page.
rules.false_positive_guard: Deliberate attribution required by a free-tier license is a choice, not residue; confirm intent.

rules.message: TODO/FIXME/placeholder text is visible to readers.
rules.false_positive_guard: A changelog or issue tracker legitimately displays the words; confirm the surface is product UI.

rules.message: Inline script swallows exceptions in an empty catch block; failures disappear.
rules.false_positive_guard: A catch that intentionally falls back must show the fallback nearby; read the handler before reporting.
